lines.name: l1
lines.text: They laughed at the janitor for six hours. It took him ten seconds.

lines.name: l2
lines.text: Three engineers couldn't start the engine. The test was in the morning.

lines.name: l3
lines.text: He listened for ten seconds. Then he tightened one bolt.

lines.name: l4
lines.text: The engine started on the first try.

lines.name: l5
lines.text: Nobody knew he had designed it. Thirty years ago.
